added_failures_note: The reviewed node was suite-unarmed: baseline_suite and after_suite are empty, so zero denotes no comparable suite pair and is not a measured absence of added failures.

assertion_analysis.failure_condition: A rotating case reaches the static polynomial edge calculation.
A saved wall differs from the independently regenerated limiter geometry by more than 2e-13 m.
The analytic edge maximum differs from the independently geometry-selected designed contact by more than 1e-10 m.
The wall scan has no flux range above 1 Wb, such as a uniform or zero instrument.
Flux at the known magnetic axis differs from the analytic axis parameter by at least 1e-12 Wb.
The computed maximum is farther than 1e-11 Wb from the absolute zero-flux contact.
Either 1 mm or 0.5 mm scan misses the polynomial maximum by at least 1e-6 Wb.
Any designed, extremal, saved-oracle or route point is more than 1e-10 m off the saved wall.
The saved oracle point ceases to be the best vertex or its flux is no longer below -0.049 Wb; this guards reproduction of the archived defect, not correctness of the analytic boundary.

The separately saved receipt and NPZ disagree about the oracle point, or the recorded ratio leaves the documented range; they can still agree if the same upstream selector changes both, so correctness rests on lines 116-121.
JAX x64 is off or a non-CPU backend is selected, invalidating the stated execution conditions.

assertion_input_coupling: No added assertion compares a returned value directly with the same value passed to that function. The receipt-versus-NPZ equality at lines 167-169 is cross-artifact consistency, not an independent analytic boundary oracle, and is not credited for durability.
